No Result View All Result Home News Politics Business Sport Football Health Entertainment Education Opinion Editorial Columns Others LeVogue Magazine Conferences National Economy Contact Us Hausa Edition Home News Politics Business Sport Football Health Entertainment Education Opinion Editorial Columns Others LeVogue Magazine Conferences National Economy Contact Us No Result View All Result No Result View All Result 2027: Kabo APC Members Rally Support for Tinubu, Yusuf, Barau by Longtong Yakubu 2 minutes ago in News , Politics Share on WhatsApp Share on Facebook Share on X Telegram Members of the All Progressives Congress (APC) in Kabo Local Government Area of Kano State have rallied support for President Bola Tinubu, Kano State Governor Abba Kabir Yusuf and Deputy President of the Senate, Senator Barau Jibrin, ahead of the 2027 general elections.
The party members toured communities across the area before converging in Kabo to demonstrate their support for the three political leaders.
The gathering was also aimed at mobilising grassroots backing for the leaders as political activities gradually build towards the 2027 elections.
Dankabo described the turnout as an encouraging sign for the alliance, saying its members were determined to continue engaging residents and strengthening support across the area.
He said the group would sustain its mobilisation activities until it achieved its objectives.
The convener also said the alliance would remain committed to the trust placed in its members by supporters.
Dankabo said the gathering had given the alliance confidence about the electoral prospects of Tinubu, Yusuf and Barau.
“This gathering already I can see very good sign for victory, its going to be a very big win for President Bola Tinubu, and the Governor, His Excellency Abba Kabir Yusuf and Distinguished Senator Barau Jibrin.”
He also expressed confidence that residents of Kabo would support the leaders at the polls.
“I am quite sure that people of Kabo will vote for the President because this people believe in us, they trust us and we are not going to mislead them.”
The statements reflect the alliance convener’s expectations and political position ahead of the elections. The eventual voting decisions of residents will be determined at the polls.
The mobilisation in Kabo highlights the importance of grassroots political engagement as parties and support groups prepare for the 2027 general elections.
Community visits, local meetings and political alliances can provide a platform for supporters to promote candidates and communicate their political priorities to residents.
For the Tinubu Abba Barau Alliance, the Kabo gathering represents an effort to demonstrate local support for the three leaders.
However, the size of the gathering alone does not establish the level of electoral support the candidates will receive across Kabo or Kano State.
Further mobilisation activities and developments within the APC are likely to shape political discussions in the state as the elections approach.
